extracted.name: Slow Cooker Tapioca Pudding
extracted.description: This creamy and comforting tapioca pudding is made in the slow cooker with milk, sugar, small pearl tapioca, and eggs for a no-fuss, make-ahead dessert.
instruction_lines: Stir together milk, sugar, tapioca, and beaten eggs in a slow cooker until well combined.
Cook on Low for 6 hours or High for 3 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve warm.
